title: Over-complicating tiling behaviour
author: Such--Balance
selftext:
Trying to create some alien type of slime-mold like territory. Because after all..why not over-complicate basic tiling with a plethora of different interacting shaders and boundary rules. Got like 5 different shaders all doing something else to the terrain. Gamedevs will wisely point out to start simple..this is the dawn of ai though..we go balls deep because we can.

Still a work in progress but quite happy with the now automatic borer transition logic. I would like a bit more feeling of depth still..like the alien...stuff has eaten away the terrain having it be slightly sunk in.

But its really starting to look like some organic...stuff.

Also, say goodbye to painstakingly creating all kinds of transition tiles!
